create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a fairchem job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
create_scheduler_config: create a SchedulerConfig dataclass to configure local or SLURM scheduling with distributed init method and node count
create_slurm_config: create a SlurmConfig dataclass to configure SLURM job parameters like memory, timeout, CPUs per task, and partition
create_metadata: create a Metadata dataclass to store read-only job metadata including commit hash, log dir, and checkpoint dir
create_slurm_env: create a SlurmEnv dataclass to capture SLURM environment variables like job ID, array task ID, and restart count
